description: This file implements a simple, customizable logger utility with support for logging levels, namespacing, and environment-based configuration. It exports a function to create logger instances and a default logger for application-wide use.

methods.name: createLogger(namespace = 'app')
methods.description: Creates a logger instance with a specified namespace, supporting multiple log levels and safe console logging.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: A no-operation method intended for API completeness; actual level control is via environment variable at build time.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the current log level as a string based on environment setting.
